description_short: Generate ASCII art, Mermaid diagrams, and compact flow visualizations of attack paths.
description_long: Renders attack paths as Mermaid flowcharts, ASCII box-and-arrow chains or a compact one-line flow. Reads an adversary_path_projector path graph or a threat_intel_ingester json_events artifact by artifact_id, or inline stages. On a path graph, nodes are keyed by technique and tactic and are component-blind: component, controls, step state and the detection designer's assessment are not drawn, so the picture orients a reader and is not the record. Inline stages are the one route that draws controls, gaps and a control coverage matrix. No LLM.
author: Event Mill Contributors
